faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VOCPA Senior Deputy Secretary recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority Senior Deputy Secretary position is 29th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Deputy Secretary post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a degree from a recognized University and have twelve years of experience in an Executive cadre in General Administration, Personnel, or Industrial Relations within industrial, commercial, or government undertakings.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Deputy Secretary position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Deputy Secretary post is 42 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Deputy Secretary role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Deputy Secretary position will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 2,20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the VOCPA Senior Deputy Secretary job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Deputy Secretary post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Deputy Secretary in the V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation, indicating that the position is filled by officers on deputation from other government departments or organizations.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What are the selection methods for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes absorption through a composite method, deputation, and direct recruitment, as outlined in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can typically be downloaded from the official website of the V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority. Links are provided in the Important Links section.
